title: Tiếng Anh giao tiếp hằng ngày
overview: Lộ trình cốt lõi 16 bài từ A1 đến B2: chào hỏi, thói quen, mua sắm, kể chuyện, nêu ý kiến và thảo luận. Mỗi bài có từ vựng, ngữ pháp, phát âm, hội thoại và bài kiểm tra 10 câu.

lessons.title: Chào hỏi và giới thiệu bản thân
lessons.objective: Chào hỏi, nói tên, quê quán, nghề nghiệp và hỏi lại người khác.
lessons.reading:
Anna: Hi! I'm Anna. What's your name?
Minh: Hello, Anna. My name is Minh. Nice to meet you.
Anna: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
Minh: I'm from Da Nang, in Vietnam. And you?
Anna: I'm from Canada. I'm a teacher. What do you do?
Minh: I'm a student. I study engineering.

vocabulary.example: Nice to meet you, I'm Minh.
Where are you from? I'm from Hue.
What do you do? I'm a nurse.
My sister is a student at the university.
Our teacher is very kind.
I like coffee too.

grammar.title: Động từ to be: am / is / are
grammar.explanation: Dùng 'am' với I, 'is' với he/she/it, 'are' với you/we/they. Câu hỏi đảo to be lên trước: Are you a student? Phủ định thêm 'not': I am not tired.
examples: I am a teacher.
She is from Japan.
Are you from Vietnam? – Yes, I am.

pronunciation.tip: Người Việt hay nuốt âm cuối. Hãy ngậm môi khi kết thúc 'name' (/neɪm/) và rung nhẹ /z/ ở 'is' (/ɪz/).

speakingTasks: Giới thiệu tên, quê quán và nghề nghiệp của bạn trong 3 câu.
Hỏi lại thầy/cô 2 câu: tên và quê quán.

questions.prompt: Where is Minh from?
questions.explanation: Minh nói: 'I'm from Da Nang, in Vietnam.'

questions.prompt: What does Anna do?
questions.explanation: Anna nói: 'I'm a teacher.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'she' đi với 'is'.

questions.prompt: Someone says “Nice to meet you.” What is the best reply?
questions.explanation: Đáp lại lời chào làm quen bằng 'Nice to meet you too.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- với to be: Wh- + are + you + ...?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: My sister is a _____ at the university.
questions.explanation: “student” nghĩa là “học sinh, sinh viên”. Câu đầy đủ: My sister is a student at the university.

questions.prompt: What does “student” mean?
questions.explanation: “student” = học sinh, sinh viên. Ví dụ: My sister is a student at the university.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I like coffee _____.
questions.explanation: “too” nghĩa là “cũng (cuối câu)”. Câu đầy đủ: I like coffee too.

questions.prompt: What does “Where are you from?” mean?
questions.explanation: “Where are you from?” = Bạn đến từ đâu?. Ví dụ: Where are you from? I'm from Hue.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Our _____ is very kind.
questions.explanation: “teacher” nghĩa là “giáo viên”. Câu đầy đủ: Our teacher is very kind.

lessons.title: Gia đình và con số
lessons.objective: Nói về các thành viên trong gia đình, tuổi và số lượng.
lessons.reading: This is my family. My father is fifty-two years old. He is a driver. My mother is forty-eight. She is a cook. I have one brother and two sisters. My brother is twenty. My sisters are twelve and fifteen. We have a small house and a dog. I love my family.

vocabulary.example: My father is a driver.
My mother cooks very well.
I have one brother.
My sister is twelve years old.
He is twenty years old.
We have a small house.

grammar.title: have / has để nói sở hữu
grammar.explanation: I/you/we/they + have; he/she/it + has. Hỏi: Do you have...? / Does she have...? Trả lời: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
examples: I have two sisters.
She has a dog.
Do you have a brother? – Yes, I do.

pronunciation.tip: Thirteen nhấn âm cuối (thir-TEEN), thirty nhấn âm đầu (THIR-ty). Phân biệt rõ để không nhầm 13 với 30.

speakingTasks: Giới thiệu gia đình bạn: có mấy người, mỗi người bao nhiêu tuổi, làm nghề gì.
Hỏi thầy/cô: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

questions.prompt: How old is the father?
questions.explanation: 'My father is fifty-two years old.'

questions.prompt: How many sisters does the writer have?
questions.explanation: 'I have one brother and two sisters.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: He/she/it dùng 'has'.

questions.prompt: Which number is 15?
questions.explanation: 15 = fifteen; 50 = fifty.

questions.prompt: “Do you have a brother?” – Choose the correct short answer.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi với 'Do' trả lời bằng 'do/don't'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: My _____ is a driver.
questions.explanation: “father” nghĩa là “bố”. Câu đầy đủ: My father is a driver.

questions.prompt: What does “sister” mean?
questions.explanation: “sister” = chị/em gái. Ví dụ: My sister is twelve years old.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: My _____ cooks very well.
questions.explanation: “mother” nghĩa là “mẹ”. Câu đầy đủ: My mother cooks very well.

questions.prompt: What does “years old” mean?
questions.explanation: “years old” = tuổi. Ví dụ: He is twenty years old.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I have one _____.
questions.explanation: “brother” nghĩa là “anh/em trai”. Câu đầy đủ: I have one brother.

lessons.title: Thói quen hằng ngày
lessons.objective: Kể về một ngày bình thường với thì hiện tại đơn và giờ giấc.
lessons.reading: Lan gets up at six o'clock every morning. She has breakfast at half past six and goes to work by bus. She starts work at eight. At noon she eats lunch with her colleagues. She finishes work at five and goes home. In the evening she watches TV or reads a book. She goes to bed at ten thirty.

vocabulary.example: I get up at six o'clock.
We have breakfast at home.
She goes to work by bus.
They finish work at five.
I read books in the evening.
He goes to bed at eleven.

grammar.title: Hiện tại đơn với he/she/it thêm -s/-es
grammar.explanation: Dùng hiện tại đơn cho thói quen, lịch trình. Ngôi thứ ba số ít thêm -s (works) hoặc -es (goes, watches). Phủ định: doesn't + động từ nguyên mẫu.
examples: She works in an office.
He watches TV every night.
Lan doesn't drive to work.

pronunciation.tip: works /s/, goes /z/, watches /ɪz/. Đừng bỏ âm cuối — nó cho biết chủ ngữ là ngôi thứ ba.

speakingTasks: Kể 4–5 việc bạn làm mỗi ngày, có giờ cụ thể.
Hỏi thầy/cô: What time do you get up?

questions.prompt: How does Lan go to work?
questions.explanation: 'goes to work by bus'.

questions.prompt: What time does Lan go to bed?
questions.explanation: 'She goes to bed at ten thirty' = 10:30.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She goes to work at eight.
She going to work at eight.
She go to work at eight.
questions.explanation: Ngôi thứ ba số ít: goes.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative.
questions.explanation: doesn't + động từ nguyên mẫu (like).

questions.prompt: “Half past six” means…
questions.explanation: Half past six = 6 giờ 30.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We _____ at home.
questions.explanation: “have breakfast” nghĩa là “ăn sáng”. Câu đầy đủ: We have breakfast at home.

questions.prompt: What does “go to work” mean?
questions.explanation: “go to work” = đi làm. Ví dụ: She goes to work by bus.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I _____ at six o'clock.
questions.explanation: “get up” nghĩa là “thức dậy”. Câu đầy đủ: I get up at six o'clock.

questions.prompt: What does “go to bed” mean?
questions.explanation: “go to bed” = đi ngủ. Ví dụ: He goes to bed at eleven.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I read books _____.
questions.explanation: “in the evening” nghĩa là “vào buổi tối”. Câu đầy đủ: I read books in the evening.

lessons.title: Gọi đồ ăn và thức uống
lessons.objective: Gọi món ở quán cà phê, hỏi giá và trả tiền lịch sự.
lessons.reading:
Waiter: Hi! What can I get you?
Customer: Can I have a coffee with milk, please?
Waiter: Hot or iced?
Customer: Iced, please. And a sandwich.
Waiter: Sure. Anything else?
Customer: No, thank you. How much is it?
Waiter: That's six dollars fifty.
Customer: Here you are.

vocabulary.example: Can I have a tea, please?
Anything else? – No, thank you.
How much is it? – Five dollars.
Here you are. Thank you!
I'd like an iced tea.
A sandwich, please.

grammar.title: Danh từ đếm được với a/an
grammar.explanation: Dùng 'a' trước phụ âm (a sandwich), 'an' trước nguyên âm (an orange juice). Đồ uống gọi theo cốc cũng dùng a/an: a coffee, an iced tea.
examples: I'd like a coffee.
Can I have an apple juice?
She wants a sandwich and an egg.

pronunciation.focus: Ngữ điệu lên khi hỏi Yes/No
pronunciation.tip: Câu 'Can I have a coffee?' lên giọng ở cuối. Câu hỏi Wh- như 'How much is it?' xuống giọng.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai: bạn gọi một đồ uống và một món ăn, hỏi giá.
Thầy/cô là người phục vụ — trả lời các câu hỏi của thầy/cô.

questions.prompt: What does the customer order?
options: A hot coffee and a cake
An iced coffee with milk and a sandwich
questions.explanation: Khách gọi 'a coffee with milk… Iced… And a sandwich'.

questions.prompt: How much does the customer pay?
questions.explanation: 'six dollars fifty' = $6.50.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation: 'orange' bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → an.

questions.prompt: The waiter asks “Anything else?” You don't want more. You say:
questions.explanation: Từ chối lịch sự: No, thank you.

questions.prompt: Which is the most polite way to order?
options: Can I have a coffee, please?
questions.explanation: 'Can I have…, please?' là cách gọi lịch sự.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ – No, thank you.
questions.explanation: “Anything else?” nghĩa là “Còn gì nữa không?”. Câu đầy đủ: Anything else? – No, thank you.

questions.prompt: What does “iced” mean?
questions.explanation: “iced” = có đá, lạnh. Ví dụ: I'd like an iced tea.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ Thank you!
questions.explanation: “Here you are.” nghĩa là “Của bạn đây. (khi đưa đồ/tiền)”. Câu đầy đủ: Here you are. Thank you!

questions.prompt: What does “please” mean?
questions.explanation: “please” = làm ơn (lịch sự). Ví dụ: A sandwich, please.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'd like an _____ tea.
questions.explanation: “iced” nghĩa là “có đá, lạnh”. Câu đầy đủ: I'd like an iced tea.

lessons.title: Kể về cuối tuần trước
lessons.objective: Kể lại sự việc đã xảy ra bằng thì quá khứ đơn (có quy tắc và bất quy tắc).
lessons.reading: Last weekend was great. On Saturday morning I visited my grandparents in the countryside. We cooked lunch together and talked for hours. In the afternoon I went fishing with my cousin, but we didn't catch anything! On Sunday I stayed at home, cleaned my room and watched a film. I felt relaxed and ready for the new week.

vocabulary.example: What did you do last weekend?
I visited my grandparents.
They live in the countryside.
We went fishing on Saturday.
I stayed at home on Sunday.
I felt relaxed after the holiday.

grammar.title: Quá khứ đơn: -ed và động từ bất quy tắc
grammar.explanation: Động từ có quy tắc thêm -ed (visited, cooked). Bất quy tắc phải học thuộc: go → went, feel → felt, catch → caught. Phủ định và câu hỏi dùng did + động từ nguyên mẫu: I didn't go. Did you go?
examples: I watched a film last night.
We went to the beach.
Did you catch any fish? – No, we didn't.

pronunciation.tip: cooked /t/, stayed /d/, visited /ɪd/. Chỉ đọc /ɪd/ khi động từ tận cùng bằng t hoặc d.

speakingTasks: Kể 3–4 việc bạn đã làm cuối tuần trước.
Hỏi thầy/cô: What did you do last weekend?

questions.prompt: Who did the writer visit on Saturday morning?
questions.explanation: 'I visited my grandparents in the countryside.'

questions.prompt: Did they catch any fish?
questions.explanation: 'we didn't catch anything!'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form of “go”.
questions.explanation: go → went (bất quy tắc).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Did + động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: How is the -ed in “visited” pronounced?
questions.explanation: visit tận cùng bằng 't' → /ɪd/.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What did you do _____?
questions.explanation: “last weekend” nghĩa là “cuối tuần trước”. Câu đầy đủ: What did you do last weekend?

questions.prompt: What does “last weekend” mean?
questions.explanation: “last weekend” = cuối tuần trước. Ví dụ: What did you do last weekend?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: They live in the _____.
questions.explanation: “countryside” nghĩa là “vùng quê”. Câu đầy đủ: They live in the countryside.

questions.prompt: What does “visit” mean?
questions.explanation: “visit” = thăm. Ví dụ: I visited my grandparents.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I _____ed my grandparents.
questions.explanation: “visit” nghĩa là “thăm”. Câu đầy đủ: I visited my grandparents.

lessons.title: Hỏi và chỉ đường
lessons.objective: Hỏi đường lịch sự và hiểu chỉ dẫn: rẽ, đi thẳng, đối diện, bên cạnh.
lessons.reading:
Tourist: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
Local: Yes, there is. Go straight on for about two hundred metres. Then turn left at the traffic lights.
Tourist: Turn left at the lights. OK.
Local: The pharmacy is on your right, next to the bank and opposite the park.
Tourist: Is it far?
Local: No, it's only five minutes on foot.

vocabulary.example: Excuse me, where is the station?
Go straight on for two hundred metres.
Turn left at the traffic lights.
The bank is next to the pharmacy.
The café is opposite the park.
It's ten minutes on foot.

grammar.title: There is / There are và giới từ chỉ vị trí
grammar.explanation: There is + danh từ số ít, There are + số nhiều. Giới từ vị trí: next to, opposite, between, behind, in front of, on the corner.
examples: There is a bank next to the hotel.
There are two cafés on this street.
The shop is between the bank and the park.

pronunciation.tip: Nối phụ âm cuối với âm đầu tiếp theo cho trôi chảy: 'turn‿left', 'next‿to the bank'.

speakingTasks: Chỉ đường từ nhà bạn đến quán cà phê gần nhất.
Hỏi thầy/cô đường đến ga tàu một cách lịch sự.

questions.prompt: What is the tourist looking for?
questions.explanation: 'is there a pharmacy near here?'

questions.prompt: Where should the tourist turn left?
questions.explanation: 'turn left at the traffic lights'.

questions.prompt: Where is the pharmacy?
questions.explanation: 'next to the bank and opposite the park'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Số nhiều → There are.

questions.prompt: How long does it take on foot?
questions.explanation: 'only five minutes on foot'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The bank is _____ the pharmacy.
questions.explanation: “next to” nghĩa là “bên cạnh”. Câu đầy đủ: The bank is next to the pharmacy.

questions.prompt: What does “on foot” mean?
questions.explanation: “on foot” = đi bộ. Ví dụ: It's ten minutes on foot.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ at the traffic lights.
questions.explanation: “turn left” nghĩa là “rẽ trái”. Câu đầy đủ: Turn left at the traffic lights.

questions.prompt: What does “go straight on” mean?
questions.explanation: “go straight on” = đi thẳng. Ví dụ: Go straight on for two hundred metres.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, where is the station?
questions.explanation: “Excuse me” nghĩa là “Xin lỗi (để bắt chuyện)”. Câu đầy đủ: Excuse me, where is the station?

lessons.title: Mua sắm quần áo
lessons.objective: Hỏi kích cỡ, màu sắc, thử đồ, so sánh giá và mua hàng.
lessons.reading:
Assistant: Can I help you?
Customer: Yes, I'm looking for a jacket.
Assistant: What size are you?
Customer: Medium, I think. Do you have this one in blue?
Assistant: Yes, here you are. The fitting room is over there.
Customer: It's a bit tight. Do you have a bigger size?
Assistant: Here's a large. It's cheaper than the other jacket, too.
Customer: Perfect. I'll take it.

vocabulary.example: I'm looking for a jacket.
What size are you?
The fitting room is over there.
These shoes are too tight.
This shirt is cheap.
It looks great. I'll take it.

grammar.title: So sánh hơn: -er / more
grammar.explanation: Tính từ ngắn thêm -er (cheap → cheaper, big → bigger). Tính từ dài dùng more (more expensive). Bất quy tắc: good → better, bad → worse. Sau đó dùng 'than'.
examples: This jacket is cheaper than that one.
The red dress is more expensive.
This size is better for you.

pronunciation.tip: Đặt lưỡi chạm lợi trên rồi bật ra, môi hơi tròn: /ˈʤækɪt/, /lɑːʤ/. Không đọc thành 'giắc-két'.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai mua một chiếc áo: hỏi size, màu và giá.
So sánh hai món đồ bạn có bằng 2 câu so sánh hơn.

questions.prompt: What is the customer looking for?
questions.explanation: 'I'm looking for a jacket.'

questions.prompt: What was the problem with the first jacket?
questions.explanation: 'It's a bit tight.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative of “big”.
questions.explanation: big → bigger (gấp đôi phụ âm).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: This is more cheap than that.
questions.explanation: cheap → cheaper + than.

questions.prompt: “I'll take it” means the customer…
questions.explanation: I'll take it = tôi quyết định mua.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What _____ are you?
questions.explanation: “size” nghĩa là “kích cỡ”. Câu đầy đủ: What size are you?

questions.prompt: What does “cheap” mean?
questions.explanation: “cheap” = rẻ. Ví dụ: This shirt is cheap.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: It looks great. _____.
questions.explanation: “I'll take it” nghĩa là “Tôi lấy cái này”. Câu đầy đủ: It looks great. I'll take it.

questions.prompt: What does “I'll take it” mean?
questions.explanation: “I'll take it” = Tôi lấy cái này. Ví dụ: It looks great. I'll take it.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: This shirt is _____.
questions.explanation: “cheap” nghĩa là “rẻ”. Câu đầy đủ: This shirt is cheap.

lessons.title: Lên kế hoạch cuối tuần với bạn bè
lessons.objective: Rủ rê, gợi ý, đồng ý/từ chối khéo và nói về kế hoạch bằng 'going to'.
lessons.reading:
Mai: Are you free on Saturday?
Tom: I think so. Why?
Mai: I'm going to see a film. Would you like to come?
Tom: I'd love to! What time?
Mai: How about the seven o'clock show?
Tom: Hmm, I'm afraid I can't. I'm going to have dinner with my parents at six. What about the nine o'clock one?
Mai: Sure, that works. Let's meet outside the cinema at a quarter to nine.

vocabulary.example: Are you free on Sunday?
Would you like to come?
Coffee tomorrow? – I'd love to!
How about the seven o'clock show?
Sorry, I'm afraid I can't come.
Nine o'clock? Sure, that works.

grammar.title: be going to cho kế hoạch đã định
grammar.explanation: Dùng am/is/are going to + động từ cho dự định đã có từ trước: I'm going to visit Hue. Câu hỏi: Are you going to…?
examples: I'm going to see a film on Saturday.
She is going to study tonight.
Are you going to come? – Yes, I am.

pronunciation.focus: Dạng rút gọn: I'd, I'm, can't
pronunciation.tip: Đọc gọn: I'd /aɪd/, I'm /aɪm/. 'can't' trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ /kænt/, Anh-Anh /kɑːnt/ — luôn có âm /t/ nhẹ để phân biệt với 'can'.

speakingTasks: Rủ thầy/cô đi đâu đó cuối tuần, thương lượng thời gian.
Kể 2 kế hoạch của bạn trong tuần tới với 'going to'.

questions.prompt: What is Mai going to do on Saturday?
questions.explanation: 'I'm going to see a film.'

questions.prompt: Why can't Tom go at seven?
options: He is having dinner with his parents.
questions.explanation: 'I'm going to have dinner with my parents at six.'

questions.prompt: What time will they meet?
questions.explanation: 'a quarter to nine' = 8:45.

questions.prompt: Choose the polite way to refuse.
questions.explanation: 'I'm afraid I can't' từ chối lịch sự.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: am/is/are + going to + V.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Coffee tomorrow? – _____!
questions.explanation: “I'd love to” nghĩa là “Tôi rất sẵn lòng”. Câu đầy đủ: Coffee tomorrow? – I'd love to!

questions.prompt: What does “Would you like to…?” mean?
questions.explanation: “Would you like to…?” = Bạn có muốn… không?. Ví dụ: Would you like to come?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Nine o'clock? Sure, _____.
questions.explanation: “that works” nghĩa là “được đấy, hợp lý”. Câu đầy đủ: Nine o'clock? Sure, that works.

questions.prompt: What does “Are you free…?” mean?
questions.explanation: “Are you free…?” = Bạn có rảnh…không?. Ví dụ: Are you free on Sunday?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Sorry, _____ come.
questions.explanation: “I'm afraid I can't” nghĩa là “E là tôi không thể”. Câu đầy đủ: Sorry, I'm afraid I can't come.

lessons.title: Kinh nghiệm sống
lessons.objective: Nói về trải nghiệm bằng hiện tại hoàn thành, phân biệt với quá khứ đơn.
lessons.reading: Have you ever done something that scared you? I have. Last year I went bungee jumping in New Zealand. I had never done anything like it before. I've travelled to eight countries so far, and I've tried many unusual foods, but that jump was the most exciting thing I've ever done. I haven't done it again since then — once was enough!

vocabulary.example: Have you ever been to Japan?
I've visited eight countries so far.
I tried some unusual food in Thailand.
It was the most exciting day of my life.
I haven't seen him since then.
I've been to Paris once.

grammar.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành vs. quá khứ đơn
grammar.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + V3) nói về trải nghiệm, không nêu thời điểm: I've been to Japan. Khi nêu thời điểm cụ thể (last year, in 2020) dùng quá khứ đơn: I went there in 2020.
examples: I've tried sushi, but I've never tried snails.
She has lived here since 2019.
We visited Rome last summer.

pronunciation.tip: Trong câu nói nhanh 'I've' /aɪv/, 'she's been' /ʃiːz bɪn/. 'been' thường đọc yếu /bɪn/.

speakingTasks: Kể một trải nghiệm đáng nhớ: bạn đã làm gì, khi nào, cảm thấy thế nào.
Hỏi thầy/cô 3 câu 'Have you ever…?'

questions.prompt: Where did the writer go bungee jumping?
questions.explanation: 'in New Zealand'.

questions.prompt: How many countries has the writer visited?
questions.explanation: 'I've travelled to eight countries so far'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I went to Japan last year.
I have gone to Japan last year.
I have went to Japan last year.
questions.explanation: Có 'last year' → quá khứ đơn.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Trải nghiệm → have + V3 (eaten).

questions.prompt: “I haven't done it again since then.” means…
options: The writer did it many times.
The writer has not repeated it.
The writer will do it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Kể từ đó chưa làm lại.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: It was the most _____ day of my life.
questions.explanation: “exciting” nghĩa là “thú vị, hồi hộp”. Câu đầy đủ: It was the most exciting day of my life.

questions.prompt: What does “unusual” mean?
questions.explanation: “unusual” = khác thường, lạ. Ví dụ: I tried some unusual food in Thailand.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I've visited eight countries _____.
questions.explanation: “so far” nghĩa là “cho đến nay”. Câu đầy đủ: I've visited eight countries so far.

questions.prompt: What does “Have you ever…?” mean?
questions.explanation: “Have you ever…?” = Bạn đã từng… chưa?. Ví dụ: Have you ever been to Japan?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I've been to Paris _____.
questions.explanation: “once” nghĩa là “một lần”. Câu đầy đủ: I've been to Paris once.

lessons.title: Nêu ý kiến, đồng ý và phản đối
lessons.objective: Bày tỏ quan điểm, đồng ý một phần và phản đối lịch sự trong thảo luận.
lessons.reading:
Host: Should students wear school uniforms?
Linh: In my opinion, yes. Uniforms make everyone equal and save time in the morning.
David: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree. Students should be able to express themselves.
Linh: That's true to some extent. However, schools are places to study, not fashion shows.
David: Fair enough. Maybe a compromise is better — uniforms on some days and free choice on others.

vocabulary.example: In my opinion, uniforms are useful.
I see your point, but I disagree.

vocabulary.definition: ở một mức độ nào đó
vocabulary.example: That's true to some extent.
It's cheap. However, it's not very good.
Fair enough, let's try your idea.
We reached a compromise.

grammar.title: should / shouldn't để khuyên và nêu quan điểm
grammar.explanation: should + động từ nguyên mẫu để nói điều nên làm hoặc ý kiến: Students should read more. Phủ định shouldn't. Hỏi ý kiến: Should we…?
examples: Schools should start later.
You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
Should students wear uniforms?

pronunciation.focus: Nhấn từ để thể hiện thái độ
pronunciation.tip: Nhấn mạnh từ chứa ý kiến: 'I'm NOT sure I agree', 'That's TRUE to some extent'. Ngữ điệu mềm giúp phản đối lịch sự.

speakingTasks: Nêu ý kiến của bạn về việc dùng điện thoại trong lớp học, đưa 2 lý do.
Thầy/cô sẽ phản đối — hãy đáp lại lịch sự.

questions.prompt: What is Linh's opinion?
questions.explanation: 'In my opinion, yes.'

questions.prompt: Why does David disagree?
questions.explanation: 'Students should be able to express themselves.'

questions.prompt: Which phrase disagrees politely?
questions.explanation: 'I see your point, but…' vừa ghi nhận vừa phản đối.

questions.prompt: What compromise does David suggest?
questions.explanation: 'uniforms on some days and free choice on others'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: should + V nguyên mẫu.

questions.explanation: “I see your point” nghĩa là “Tôi hiểu ý bạn”. Câu đầy đủ: I see your point, but I disagree.

questions.prompt: What does “I see your point” mean?
options: ở một mức độ nào đó
questions.explanation: “I see your point” = Tôi hiểu ý bạn. Ví dụ: I see your point, but I disagree.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, let's try your idea.
questions.explanation: “Fair enough” nghĩa là “Cũng hợp lý”. Câu đầy đủ: Fair enough, let's try your idea.

questions.prompt: What does “However” mean?
questions.explanation: “However” = Tuy nhiên. Ví dụ: It's cheap. However, it's not very good.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We reached a _____.
questions.explanation: “compromise” nghĩa là “sự thỏa hiệp”. Câu đầy đủ: We reached a compromise.

lessons.title: Kể chuyện và sự cố
lessons.objective: Kể một câu chuyện có trình tự với quá khứ tiếp diễn và từ nối thời gian.
lessons.reading: I was walking home from work when it suddenly started to rain heavily. I didn't have an umbrella, so I ran into a small bookshop. While I was looking at the books, I noticed an old man who was trying to reach a book on the top shelf. I helped him, and we started chatting. It turned out that he was a famous writer! In the end, he signed his book for me.

vocabulary.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.
It was raining heavily.
I noticed an old man in the shop.
He couldn't reach the top shelf.
It turned out that he was a writer.
In the end, we became friends.

grammar.title: Quá khứ tiếp diễn + quá khứ đơn
grammar.explanation: Quá khứ tiếp diễn (was/were + V-ing) cho hành động đang diễn ra; quá khứ đơn cho hành động xen vào: I was walking home when it started to rain. 'While' thường đi với tiếp diễn.
examples: I was cooking when the phone rang.
While she was reading, the lights went out.
They were sleeping at midnight.

pronunciation.tip: Đuôi -ing là /ɪŋ/ — phần sau lưỡi chạm ngạc mềm, không bật /g/ mạnh và không đọc thành 'in'.

speakingTasks: Kể một chuyện bất ngờ từng xảy ra với bạn, dùng was/were + V-ing và when.
Thầy/cô sẽ hỏi chi tiết — trả lời đầy đủ câu.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer go into the bookshop?
questions.explanation: Trời mưa và không có ô nên chạy vào hiệu sách.

questions.prompt: What was the old man trying to do?
options: Reach a book on the top shelf
questions.explanation: 'trying to reach a book on the top shelf'.

questions.prompt: Who was the old man?
questions.explanation: 'he was a famous writer!'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I was walk home when it started to rain.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
I walked home when it was starting to rain suddenly.
questions.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra (was walking) bị xen vào (started).

questions.prompt: Which word shows the final event of a story?
questions.explanation: 'In the end' = cuối cùng.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, we became friends.
questions.explanation: “in the end” nghĩa là “cuối cùng”. Câu đầy đủ: In the end, we became friends.

questions.prompt: What does “notice” mean?
questions.explanation: “notice” = để ý thấy. Ví dụ: I noticed an old man in the shop.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ he was a writer.
questions.explanation: “it turned out that” nghĩa là “hóa ra là”. Câu đầy đủ: It turned out that he was a writer.

questions.prompt: What does “reach” mean?
questions.explanation: “reach” = với tới. Ví dụ: He couldn't reach the top shelf.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: He couldn't _____ the top shelf.
questions.explanation: “reach” nghĩa là “với tới”. Câu đầy đủ: He couldn't reach the top shelf.

lessons.title: Sức khỏe và lối sống
lessons.objective: Nói về thói quen lành mạnh, đưa lời khuyên và câu điều kiện loại 1.
lessons.reading:
Doctor: How have you been feeling lately?
Patient: Tired, to be honest. I work long hours and I don't get much exercise.
Doctor: How much sleep do you get?
Patient: About five hours a night.
Doctor: That isn't enough. If you sleep seven or eight hours, you'll have more energy. You should also cut down on coffee in the afternoon and try to walk for thirty minutes a day.
Patient: I'll give it a try.

vocabulary.example: I've been very busy lately.
To be honest, I'm tired.
I don't get much exercise.
Sleep gives you more energy.
You should cut down on sugar.
Yoga? I'll give it a try.

grammar.title: Câu điều kiện loại 1
grammar.explanation: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V: diễn tả kết quả có thể xảy ra trong tương lai. If you sleep more, you'll feel better. Không dùng 'will' trong mệnh đề if.
examples: If you eat well, you'll stay healthy.
If it rains, we won't go jogging.
You'll feel better if you rest.

pronunciation.focus: Trọng âm từ nhiều âm tiết
pronunciation.tip: ENergy, EXercise, HONest — các từ này nhấn âm đầu. Nhấn sai trọng âm khiến người nghe khó hiểu hơn sai nguyên âm.

speakingTasks: Mô tả lối sống hiện tại của bạn và một thói quen bạn muốn thay đổi.
Cho thầy/cô 2 lời khuyên với 'If… you'll…'

questions.prompt: What is the patient's problem?
questions.explanation: 'Tired, to be honest.'

questions.prompt: How much sleep does the patient get?
questions.explanation: 'About five hours a night.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct conditional.
options: If you slept more, you'll feel better.
If you sleep more, you'll feel better.
If you will sleep more, you feel better.
questions.explanation: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.

questions.prompt: What does the doctor advise?
options: Walk for thirty minutes a day
questions.explanation: 'try to walk for thirty minutes a day'.

questions.prompt: “Cut down on coffee” means…
questions.explanation: cut down on = giảm bớt.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Sleep gives you more _____.
questions.explanation: “energy” nghĩa là “năng lượng”. Câu đầy đủ: Sleep gives you more energy.

questions.prompt: What does “get exercise” mean?
questions.explanation: “get exercise” = tập thể dục. Ví dụ: I don't get much exercise.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, I'm tired.
questions.explanation: “to be honest” nghĩa là “thành thật mà nói”. Câu đầy đủ: To be honest, I'm tired.

questions.prompt: What does “to be honest” mean?
questions.explanation: “to be honest” = thành thật mà nói. Ví dụ: To be honest, I'm tired.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I've been very busy _____.
questions.explanation: “lately” nghĩa là “gần đây”. Câu đầy đủ: I've been very busy lately.

lessons.title: Giả định và điều ước
lessons.objective: Diễn tả tình huống giả định với câu điều kiện loại 2, loại 3 và 'I wish'.
lessons.reading: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano. I wish I had started when I was a child — if I had taken lessons back then, I would be quite good by now. My parents offered to pay for lessons, but I preferred football. Looking back, I don't regret playing sport, but I do wish I could read music. Maybe it's not too late.

vocabulary.example: If I had more free time, I'd travel.
Back then, I didn't care about music.
I would be fluent by now.
My parents offered to pay for lessons.
I don't regret my decision.
Looking back, it was a good choice.

grammar.title: Câu điều kiện loại 2, 3 và I wish
grammar.explanation: Loại 2 (không có thật ở hiện tại): If + quá khứ đơn, would + V. Loại 3 (không có thật ở quá khứ): If + had + V3, would have + V3. 'I wish + quá khứ đơn' cho hiện tại; 'I wish + had + V3' cho quá khứ. Điều kiện hỗn hợp: If I had taken lessons, I would be good now.
examples: If I were you, I would apply.
If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
I wish I spoke Japanese.

pronunciation.tip: 'I'd' có thể là 'I would' hoặc 'I had' — dựa vào động từ sau: I'd go (would), I'd gone (had). Đọc /aɪd/ nhẹ, nối vào từ sau.

speakingTasks: Nói 3 điều bạn ước khác đi trong cuộc sống hiện tại.
Kể một quyết định trong quá khứ và nói 'If I had…, I would have…'

questions.prompt: What would the writer do with more free time?
questions.explanation: 'I would learn to play the piano'.

questions.prompt: What did the writer prefer as a child?
questions.explanation: 'I preferred football'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct second conditional.
options: If I had time, I will help.
If I have time, I would help.
If I had time, I would help.
questions.explanation: Loại 2: If + quá khứ, would + V.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct third conditional.
options: If she studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied, she would pass.
questions.explanation: Loại 3: had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.prompt: “I wish I could read music” means the writer…
options: cannot read music and wants to
questions.explanation: I wish + could: mong điều hiện không có.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, I didn't care about music.
questions.explanation: “back then” nghĩa là “hồi đó”. Câu đầy đủ: Back then, I didn't care about music.

questions.prompt: What does “back then” mean?
questions.explanation: “back then” = hồi đó. Ví dụ: Back then, I didn't care about music.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____, it was a good choice.
questions.explanation: “looking back” nghĩa là “nhìn lại”. Câu đầy đủ: Looking back, it was a good choice.

questions.prompt: What does “by now” mean?
questions.explanation: “by now” = đến bây giờ. Ví dụ: I would be fluent by now.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I don't _____ my decision.
questions.explanation: “regret” nghĩa là “hối tiếc”. Câu đầy đủ: I don't regret my decision.

lessons.title: Thảo luận vấn đề xã hội
lessons.objective: Trình bày lập luận có cấu trúc, đưa ví dụ và kết luận về một chủ đề xã hội.
lessons.reading: Remote work has become increasingly common. On the one hand, it saves commuting time and allows people to balance work and family life more effectively. On the other hand, some employees feel isolated, and companies worry about collaboration. Research suggests that a hybrid model — combining office and home working — may offer the best of both worlds. Ultimately, the right approach depends on the type of job and the individual.

vocabulary.example: Remote work is increasingly popular.
Commuting takes me an hour a day.
Some remote workers feel isolated.
Good collaboration needs trust.
We use a hybrid model: three days at home.
Ultimately, it depends on the job.

grammar.title: Từ nối lập luận
grammar.explanation: Mở ý: Firstly, To begin with. Đối lập: On the one hand… On the other hand…, Whereas, Although. Bổ sung: Moreover, In addition. Kết luận: Ultimately, All things considered.
examples: On the one hand, it is convenient; on the other hand, it is lonely.
Although it saves time, it can reduce teamwork.
All things considered, a hybrid model works best.

pronunciation.tip: Ngắt hơi sau mỗi cụm ý: 'On the one hand, / it saves commuting time / and allows people / to balance work and family life.' Giúp người nghe theo kịp lập luận.

speakingTasks: Trình bày quan điểm về làm việc từ xa: 2 ưu, 2 nhược, 1 kết luận.
Thầy/cô sẽ phản biện — bảo vệ quan điểm của bạn.

questions.explanation: 'a hybrid model… may offer the best of both worlds'.

questions.explanation: “collaboration” nghĩa là “sự hợp tác”. Câu đầy đủ: Good collaboration needs trust.

questions.prompt: What does “commuting” mean?
questions.explanation: “commuting” = việc đi lại (đi làm). Ví dụ: Commuting takes me an hour a day.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ takes me an hour a day.
questions.explanation: “commuting” nghĩa là “việc đi lại (đi làm)”. Câu đầy đủ: Commuting takes me an hour a day.

questions.prompt: What does “hybrid” mean?
questions.explanation: “hybrid” = kết hợp, lai. Ví dụ: We use a hybrid model: three days at home.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Some remote workers feel _____.
questions.explanation: “isolated” nghĩa là “bị cô lập, cô đơn”. Câu đầy đủ: Some remote workers feel isolated.

lessons.title: Viết email trang trọng và khiếu nại
lessons.objective: Viết và nói lời phàn nàn trang trọng, lịch sự nhưng rõ ràng, đề nghị giải pháp.
lessons.reading:
Dear Customer Service,
I am writing to complain about an order I placed on 3 May (order no. 4521). The laptop arrived two weeks later than promised, and the screen was scratched. I would appreciate it if you could either replace the laptop or issue a full refund. I have attached photos of the damage. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
Yours faithfully,
Hoang Nam

vocabulary.term: I am writing to complain about
vocabulary.definition: Tôi viết thư để phàn nàn về
vocabulary.example: I am writing to complain about my order.
I placed an order last week.
The screen was scratched.

vocabulary.definition: Tôi sẽ rất cảm kích nếu
vocabulary.example: I would appreciate it if you could call me.
I would like a full refund.
Please reply at your earliest convenience.

grammar.title: Ngôn ngữ trang trọng và câu bị động
grammar.explanation: Văn trang trọng tránh rút gọn (I am, không I'm), dùng would/could để lịch sự, và câu bị động để tập trung vào sự việc: The laptop was delivered late. Bị động: be + V3.
examples: The parcel was delivered two weeks late.
I would be grateful if you could reply soon.
The problem has not been solved yet.

pronunciation.focus: Ngữ điệu lịch sự khi khiếu nại
pronunciation.tip: Giữ giọng bình tĩnh, xuống giọng ở cuối câu nêu sự việc; lên nhẹ ở 'could you…?' để thể hiện yêu cầu chứ không ra lệnh.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai gọi điện khiếu nại một đơn hàng bị lỗi, đề nghị giải pháp.
Đọc to email mẫu và thay bằng tình huống của bạn.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ you could call me.
options: I am writing to complain about

questions.prompt: What does “refund” mean?
questions.explanation: “refund” = hoàn tiền. Ví dụ: I would like a full refund.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Please reply _____.
questions.explanation: “at your earliest convenience” nghĩa là “sớm nhất có thể (trang trọng)”. Câu đầy đủ: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

options: Tôi sẽ rất cảm kích nếu
questions.explanation: “at your earliest convenience” = sớm nhất có thể (trang trọng). Ví dụ: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

questions.explanation: “scratched” nghĩa là “bị trầy xước”. Câu đầy đủ: The screen was scratched.

lessons.title: Thành ngữ và cụm động từ thông dụng
lessons.objective: Hiểu và dùng tự nhiên các thành ngữ, cụm động từ phổ biến trong hội thoại.
lessons.reading: I was feeling under the weather last week, so I called in sick. My manager told me not to worry — she said she would look into the problem with the project while I was away. When I got back, we sat down and went over the plan together. It turned out to be a piece of cake. I guess I was making a mountain out of a molehill.

vocabulary.example: I'm a bit under the weather today.
He called in sick this morning.
I'll look into the problem.
Let's go over the plan again.

grammar.title: Cụm động từ tách được và không tách được
grammar.explanation: Một số cụm động từ tách được (look it up, turn it off): đại từ phải đứng giữa. Một số không tách được (look into it, go over it): tân ngữ đứng sau cả cụm.
examples: Please turn it off. (không nói: turn off it)
I'll look into it tomorrow.
Let's go over it once more.

pronunciation.tip: Cụm động từ thường nhấn vào tiểu từ: look INTO, go OVER, call in SICK. Thành ngữ nhấn từ mang nghĩa: a piece of CAKE.

speakingTasks: Kể một chuyện ngắn có dùng ít nhất 3 cụm từ trong bài.
Thầy/cô nói một thành ngữ — bạn giải thích nghĩa và đặt câu.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer call in sick?
questions.explanation: 'under the weather' = không khỏe.

questions.prompt: Who looked into the project problem?
questions.explanation: 'she would look into the problem'.

questions.prompt: “It turned out to be a piece of cake” means…
questions.explanation: a piece of cake = rất dễ.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Đại từ đứng giữa cụm động từ tách được.

questions.prompt: “Making a mountain out of a molehill” means…
questions.explanation: Chuyện bé xé ra to.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'm a bit _____ today.
questions.explanation: “under the weather” nghĩa là “hơi mệt, không khỏe”. Câu đầy đủ: I'm a bit under the weather today.

questions.prompt: What does “make a mountain out of a molehill” mean?
questions.explanation: “make a mountain out of a molehill” = chuyện bé xé ra to. Ví dụ: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Don't _____.
options: make a mountain out of a molehill
questions.explanation: “make a mountain out of a molehill” nghĩa là “chuyện bé xé ra to”. Câu đầy đủ: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.

questions.prompt: What does “go over” mean?
questions.explanation: “go over” = xem lại, rà soát. Ví dụ: Let's go over the plan again.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: The test was _____.
questions.explanation: “a piece of cake” nghĩa là “dễ như ăn bánh”. Câu đầy đủ: The test was a piece of cake.
